INSERT INTO lm_sample_ledger ( id, inspection_order_id, material_id, sample_id, material_code, sample_no, quantity, recycle_quantity, consumed_quantity, unit_id, status, operation_type, operation_time, operator_id, operator_name, remark, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted ) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.inspectionOrderId}, #{item.materialId}, #{item.sampleId}, #{item.materialCode}, #{item.sampleNo}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.recycleQuantity}, #{item.consumedQuantity}, #{item.unitId}, #{item.status}, #{item.operationType}, #{item.operationTime}, #{item.operatorId}, #{item.operatorName}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.updateBy}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM lm_sample_ledger WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND sample_id IN #{id} ORDER BY operation_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM lm_sample_ledger WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY operation_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sl.id, sl.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, io.batch_no AS batchNo, m.id AS materialId, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, sl.sample_id AS sampleId, sl.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, sl.quantity AS quantity, sl.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, COALESCE(sl.consumed_quantity, '0') AS consumption, sl.unit_id AS unitId, sl.status AS status, sl.operation_type AS operationType, sl.operation_time AS operationTime, sl.operator_id AS operatorId, sl.operator_name AS operatorName, sl.remark FROM lm_sample_ledger sl INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON sl.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_sample s ON sl.sample_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE sl.is_deleted = 0
AND io.material_id IN #{mid}
AND io.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.inspectionOrderNo}, '%')
AND io.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNo}, '%')
AND sl.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.sampleNo}, '%')
sl.operation_type = 'SAMPLED' OR
sl.operation_type = 'RECEIVED' OR
sl.operation_type = 'DIVIDED' OR
sl.operation_type = 'COLLECTED' OR
sl.operation_type = 'RECYCLED' OR
sl.operation_type = 'PROCESSED' OR
AND sl.operation_time >= #{query.operationStartTime}
AND sl.operation_time <= #{query.operationEndTime}
ORDER BY sl.operation_time DESC, sl.id DESC

SELECT sl.id, sl.inspection_order_id AS inspectionOrderId, io.order_no AS inspectionOrderNo, io.batch_no AS batchNo, m.id AS materialId, m.name AS materialName, m.code AS materialCode, m.specification AS materialSpec, sl.sample_id AS sampleId, sl.sample_no AS sampleNo, s.sample_name AS sampleName, sl.quantity AS quantity, sl.recycle_quantity AS recycleQuantity, COALESCE(sl.consumed_quantity, '0') AS consumption, sl.unit_id AS unitId, sl.status AS status, sl.operation_type AS operationType, sl.operation_time AS operationTime, sl.operator_id AS operatorId, sl.operator_name AS operatorName, sl.remark FROM lm_sample_ledger sl INNER JOIN lm_inspection_order io ON sl.inspection_order_id = io.id AND io.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN lm_sample s ON sl.sample_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN lm_inspect_material m ON io.material_id = m.id WHERE sl.is_deleted = 0 AND sl.inspection_order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY sl.operation_time DESC, sl.id DESC
